_comment: The notes under a chart whose rows were cut at its type's cap (truncated: saved-chart.ts truncatedNote, workflow_chart_step.go chartTruncatedNote) and on the series past its series cap (other: saved-chart.ts otherNote, workflow_chart_step.go chartOtherNote; rest is the series count less the cap, an empty note none). The chart page and a workflow's message both write them: saved-chart.test.ts and workflow_chart_step_test.go read these same cases, so the two cannot drift apart. Every chart type has a truncated case.
